title: Unearned Months of a Move-In Concession on an Early Lease Term Agreement Exit
content:
In recapturing a move-in concession on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement, the unearned months are counted by one of three conventions, set by how far into the term the requested termination date falls, measured in full calendar months from the term start date to the termination date.

## Conventions

| Full months from the term start date to the termination date | Unearned months |
|---|---|
| At least two thirds of the term's months | The term's months multiplied by the days from the termination date to the term end date, divided by the days of the whole term with both its first and last day included (exact days) |
| Fewer than half of the term's months | The full months from the termination date to the term end date, plus one for the month in progress |
| At least half but fewer than two thirds of the term's months | The full months from the termination date to the term end date |

The days from the termination date to the term end date are the calendar days by which the termination date precedes the term end date. The unearned months are not rounded.

## Thresholds by term length (derived)

| Term's months | Two thirds | Half |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 4 months | 3 months |
| 9 | 6 months | 4.5 months |
| 12 | 8 months | 6 months |
| 15 | 10 months | 7.5 months |

## Worked cases (hypothetical 12-month term, 15 March to 14 March of the next non-leap year, 365 days)

| Termination date | Full months into the term | Convention | Unearned months |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 June | 3 (fewer than 6) | full months plus one | 8 plus 1: 9 |
| 20 September | 6 (at least 6, fewer than 8) | full months | 5 |
| 20 November | 8 (at least 8) | exact days | 12 multiplied by 114, divided by 365: about 3.7479 |

In the last case the days from 20 November to 14 March are 114 (10 in November, 31 in December, 31 in January, 28 in February, 14 in March).
